items.title: Melba Liston — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The same one that what’s-his-name’s wife – Wayne Shorter?

ctx.x: I wrote for him. I haven’t written for him since I had the stroke and all of that. I called him on the phone, but I couldn’t reach him up there, outside of New York. I can’t think of it now. He’s – it’s always fine. He lost a boy in that big thing, the airplane crash.
She did? The same one that what’s-his-name’s wife – Wayne Shorter?
Um-hmm. That was when I was trying to call him, but I didn’t reach him.
